notes: Eclipse Loop 1.3.0 - the bundle grows up. NEW: Eclipse Vibe - the 4th bundled synth. A synthesized R&B/trap/hip-hop drum machine: tunable 808 (pitch-env boom, glide, drive), two snares with a TYPE knob (Trap/Acoustic/Clap-Snare/Rimshot), finger snap, hats/rim/tom/kick, NOTE REPEAT (tempo-synced rolls), MIDI out, 6 presets, 4 themes. Arranger: record MIDI and it plays back through the track's instrument; a new piano-roll MIDI clip editor (double-click to draw notes) with tools + snap; QUANTIZE menu (grid, strength, time signatures); hybrid tracks; per-track input in the mixer. Eclipse Dusk overhaul (distinct engines, layering, full ADSR, Tape Echo, grain viz). Freeze Pad Pitch toggle. Stability: fixed a host-teardown crash. Now 4 synths + 25 FX bundled.
